LINKED_GUARD.name: Linked Guard
LINKED_GUARD.description: Gain Block. Queue Block for the next teammate. Gain 1 Resonance.

TARGET_MARK.name: Target Mark
TARGET_MARK.description: Apply Vulnerable to all enemies. Empower the next teammate's first Attack. Gain 1 Resonance.

RESONANCE_PREP.name: Resonance Prep
RESONANCE_PREP.description: Draw. Reduce next teammate's first card cost. Gain Resonance if applied.

ECHO_CIRCUIT.name: Echo Circuit
ECHO_CIRCUIT.description: Gain Block. If Resonance is high enough, draw extra cards.

RESONANT_STRIKE.name: Resonant Strike
RESONANT_STRIKE.description: Deal damage. Spend up to 3 Resonance for bonus damage.

CHAIN_REPAIR.name: Chain Repair
CHAIN_REPAIR.description: Help a teammate by cleansing or granting Block. Gain 2 Resonance.

OVERLOAD_REDIRECT.name: Overload Redirect
OVERLOAD_REDIRECT.description: Lose HP, gain Resonance, and feed the next teammate card draw.

FINALE_OF_ACCORD.name: Finale of Accord
FINALE_OF_ACCORD.description: AOE finisher. If enough Link triggers happened, spend Resonance for an encore.
